structure: Part 7 read in full: e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js (306 lines, 9 tests in 3 describes: overall dashboard (3 tests: the overall dashboard at the mount root, the /dashboard redirect, the prototype index), category dashboards (3 tests: live animals tabs, search, filters and cards; live animals filtered results; germinal products), at a glance drill-downs (3 tests: /actions, /changes, /inspection)); e2e/manage-notifications.fit.spec.js (214 lines, 7 tests in 5 describes: view a notification from the dashboard (2 tests: submitted with action required and its Actions menu; submitted, past and draft), amend a submitted notification (2 tests: confirm, change, save and return, resubmit; cancel an amendment), amend and copy guards (1 test), copy as new (1 test), delete a notification (1 test)); e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines; these specs call url, urlFor, expectHeading, expectBackLink, clickAction, submitForm, pickFromAutocomplete, fillDate and dateFromToday) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines; an auto fixture that records each test's main-frame navigations for the trace index, test tooling with nothing a user observes). Claims follow the specs in file order: overall dashboard, prototype index, category dashboards (cards, tabs, search, sort, filters, filtered results), the three drill-downs, then the review page per status, its Actions menu, amend confirm, amend review and save and return, resubmission, cancel amend, guards, copy as new and delete, then the shared journey.js mechanics these tests rest on. All paths are under /design-release-2.1. Gaps record what the covers ask for that these tests do not assert: drill-down table columns, make-template's destination, and guards for delete and make-template.
